g.title: VectorMapNet has three stages
g.desc: Header: the model is a three-stage pipeline

g.data-cue-label: bird's-eye-view extractor maps each modality into shared space
g.title: BEV feature extractor maps each modality into a shared top-down space
g.desc: Camera through ResNet and inverse perspective mapping, LiDAR through PointPillars, fused by concatenation

g.data-cue-label: detection transformer with element queries locates each element
g.title: A detection transformer with element queries locates each element
g.desc: DETR-style element queries and deformable attention predict keypoints and class labels

g.data-cue-label: autoregressive polyline generator emits ordered vertices
g.title: An autoregressive polyline generator emits ordered vertices
g.desc: Autoregressive Transformer decodes each element into ordered polyline vertices, trained with detection and generation loss

g.text: Bipartite-matching detection loss + polyline generation loss,
